title: Bread prices in Midgard edge up as millers hold margins

facts.subject: Bread prices
facts.statement: Midgard bakeries have raised the price of a standard loaf again this year, citing higher energy and transport costs.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard bakeries have raised the price of a standard loaf again this year, citing higher energy and transport costs.

facts.subject: Flour prices
facts.statement: Millers say flour prices have been stable and that the increase is mostly in distribution.

source_ref.text_snippet: Millers say flour prices have been stable and that the increase is mostly in distribution.

facts.subject: Consumer office monitoring
facts.statement: The consumer office says it is monitoring the trend but sees no shortage.

facts.subject: Supermarket chains
facts.statement: Supermarket chains say they have absorbed part of the increase.
